description: Harden the deliverable: a no-network/no-key automated test suite (the safety net), full README documentation, .env.example, and a final content-integrity/neutrality pass. After this feature the project is ready for the orchestrator to push and open a PR.
steps: Create tests/ (pytest) that run with NO network and NO API keys using the dry-run path + bundled fixtures. Cover: (1) reference/topic normalization (verse ref parsing AND topic->candidate passages); (2) EACH source connector against recorded fixtures (bible_api, strongs, commentary) including the public-domain allowlist rejecting NIV/ESV; (3) the LLM abstraction via the deterministic stub provider; (4) dossier schema validation (a known-good dossier passes, a malformed one fails); (5) an END-TO-END dry-run producing a schema-valid dossier for both a verse and a topic; (6) graceful degradation: a simulated unavailable source records a gap and does not raise.

Add tests/fixtures/ with recorded connector responses and an expected sample dossier. Ensure tests force offline/dry-run (e.g. monkeypatch the HTTP getter to raise if called) so a real network call during tests is treated as a failure.

Verify the suite is green: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` with OPENAI_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset passes. Also sanity-check `.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests` works or document pytest as the required runner.
Create .env.example documenting OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and optional config env vars (provider/model/translations/dry-run) with placeholder values only (no real secrets).

Rewrite README.md (replacing the 11-byte stub) with: project intro (this is BOT #1, the Deep Research agent, of a planned multi-bot faith-content video company), setup (python3.12 venv + pip install -e '.[dev]'), env vars + pointer to .env.example, how to run LIVE vs DRY-RUN (exact commands), architecture (source-connector abstraction + how to add a connector, LLM provider abstraction incl. stub, the 6 pipeline stages, caching, graceful degradation), the dossier JSON SCHEMA (document the fields + schema_version + where the schema file lives), the content-integrity principles (citations required, uncertainty flagged, NON-DENOMINATIONAL neutrality with 66-book shared-canon baseline, no scraping of copyrighted modern translations), the v1 wired sources list (bible-api.com public-domain KJV/WEB/ASV; public-domain Strong's lexicon; CCEL/New Advent Fathers/sacred-texts/Gutenberg public-domain commentary), and a ROADMAP note listing the downstream bots (scriptwriter, TTS voiceover, visuals, video assembly, YouTube publisher, review dashboard) and that output is a human-review-gated handoff.
Final pass: confirm .gitignore ignores .venv/, __pycache__/, .cache/, output/, .env; confirm no secrets are committed; confirm requirements.txt deps are pinned.
acceptance_criteria: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` passes with NO network and NO API keys set.
Tests fail loudly if any real network call is attempted during the suite (HTTP getter is stubbed to raise).
README documents setup, live vs dry-run commands, architecture, the dossier schema, content-integrity principles, v1 sources, and the multi-bot roadmap.
.env.example exists with placeholder-only values; .gitignore ignores caches/outputs/.env/venv; requirements are pinned; no secrets committed.
verification: Run: unset OPENAI_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q and confirm all tests pass with no network access.
Run: grep -rnI -e 'sk-ant' -e 'sk-proj' -e 'sk-' . --include=*.py --include=*.toml --include=*.txt --include=*.example 2>/dev/null and confirm no real key values are present.
Confirm README.md is substantially larger than the original stub and contains the sections: Setup, Dry-run, Architecture, Dossier Schema, Sources, Roadmap.
findings: Added pytest suite under tests/ (49 tests) covering normalization (verse + topic), each connector (bible_api incl. NIV/ESV refusal and a recorded bible-api.com passage body, strongs, commentary incl. allowlist), the stub LLM provider, schema validation (good + several malformed cases), end-to-end dry-run for verse and topic, and graceful degradation. tests/conftest.py has an autouse guard that unsets API keys and monkeypatches cache.default_http_getter to raise NetworkAccessError, so any real network call fails the suite; connectors also run on an offline Cache. Added pyproject [tool.pytest.ini_options] (pythonpath/testpaths/addopts) so the suite runs from repo root without an editable install. Verified: `unset OPENAI_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` -> 49 passed, offline. Note: tests are pytest-style functions, so `python -m unittest discover` collects 0; README documents pytest as the required runner. Rewrote README.md (12.3KB) with Setup, Dry-run vs Live, Testing, Architecture (connector + LLM abstractions + 6 stages + caching + graceful degradation), Dossier schema, Sources, content-integrity principles, and the multi-bot Roadmap. Expanded .env.example with placeholder-only keys + optional config vars. Confirmed .gitignore ignores .venv/ __pycache__/ .cache/ output/ .env; requirements pinned; no secrets committed. The 'Song of Songs' three-word book name is NOT matched by the existing reference regex in pipeline.py (max two book words); test uses supported references and does not change pipeline scope.
